reviews.text: Tonight was my first time taking our pet to this clinic and I will be back when necessary. The staff was very nice , informative, kind and understanding. The doctor was detailed and explained everything to me in detail. The office was clean, and they have snacks, drinks and phone chargers. Prices are reasonable.the wait time was fine. I got there at 9 and left at 11pm
Dr David McGookey, Connery and Roxanne were so kind and attentive to us and our puppy, Lexi. She was taken good care of while she was there and they answered all of our questions.

If I could give Zero stars I would this place is horrible. I took my dog here spent over $1300 that I thought I was doing the most best in my dogs. Best interest They told me nothing was wrong with my dog. My dog would heal on His own, my dog had a limp paw fast-forward, took him to a different hospital and they tell me my Dogs arm needs to be amputated that his injury would never heal on its own what a waste !!!! don’t come here
Terrible service and doctor, my cat is still here with us, lady in cat scrubs needs to be fired, i am proceeding with legal charges
Don't bring your dogs here, I spent over $3,000 and my dog ​​still lost his eye, they only care about the money.

Our beagle had a severe allergic reaction to a ProHeart and a flea/tick shot he had received earlier that day. Since this emergency animal hospital was the closest to us, we rushed him there, and we’re so thankful we did.
From the moment we walked in, every member of the staff treated us with kindness, compassion, and genuine care. They acted quickly to assess and treat our dog while also taking the time to keep us informed. With this being a very stressful and emotional situation, their professionalism and empathy made all the difference.
Thanks to their excellent care, our beagle was back to his old self in a matter of hours and we are incredibly grateful to everyone who helped him. We truly couldn’t have asked for a better experience and highly recommend this hospital to anyone in need of emergency veterinary care. Thank you for taking such wonderful care of our furry family member!

Amazing place! Wonderful staff and incredible vet. Took outstanding care of my very ill dog and forever thankful for this place and their team. Highly recommend - don't go anywhere else but here for your pet's emergency needs. FYI VCA Hospital off I-10 , was horrible and put us on a 9 hour wait list. We were immediately seen here at Animal Emergency hospital. A++

WELL LET ME START BY SAYING. WHAT IS  CONSIDERED AN EMERGENCY AT THIS CLINC? 2 ALMOST 3 HOURS PATIENTLY WAITING IN A ROOM JUST TO CHECK MY BELOVED  CAT "SAM" WHICH  IN OUR CASE IS AN EMERGENCY. TO BE TOLD IT'LL BE ANOTHER 3 TO 4 MORE  HRS. BECAUSE THERE WERE OTHER  EMERGENCIES. THAT WERE GONNA TAKE ALL THAT TIME. TO ATTEND MY SAM.
SO I'M NOT GIVING ANY STARS TO THIS EMERGENCY VET CLINIC/HOSPITAL SORRY TO SAY DON'T  TAKE YOUR  PETS HERE. OMG STILL  HAD TO ADD A FREAKEN STAR TO POST THIS.

This place was the most affordable place I found in San Antonio. They were so quick very friendly, quick to assess the situation. If anything happens I will be going back because service was great. Juanita showed and explained everything well and Roxann was really kind and sweet Jack is healing nicely thanks to them.

Had to bring my pet to Animal Emergency Room, and I was pretty stressed when we got there. The staff was kind and helped calm things down right away. They explained what they were doing, gave me updates, and didn’t make me feel like I was asking too many questions.

Emergency visits are never fun, but I felt like my pet was being cared for by people who actually cared. I really appreciated how patient and professional everyone was during a scary situation.

My pet got some grass caught in their eye and the doctor was knowledgeable and patient as they explained what the different treatment options were. They were able to talk about what the most affordable and least traumatic option was for my furry baby. Overall a great experience. She (my pet) is doing great now!

I would not consider this an actual emergency vet clinic. I brought my dog in expecting emergency care and was told by the front desk that the doctor would not be seeing any more patients because he had an early morning with scheduled procedures.

When you bring your pet to an emergency clinic, it’s usually because you’re scared and need immediate help. Being turned away for that reason was extremely disappointing and frustrating. Pet owners rely on emergency services to be available when urgent situations happen, and unfortunately that was not my experience here.

We have used this veterinary emergency clinic several times for foster dogs we foster through ACS, and I truly cannot say enough good things about them. Every single time, they have been kind, compassionate, patient, and incredibly thorough.

Having a foster dog in an emergency situation is stressful and emotional, but they always take the time to explain everything they did, what is going on, and what the next steps are. They never make me feel like a bother when I call multiple times throughout the night to check in either.

A special thank you to Elizabeth Jordan — she is an absolute sweetheart. She is so reassuring, caring, and keeps me informed every step of the way. You can tell she truly cares about the animals and the people who love them.

Thank you all for everything you do for these dogs. It means more than you know. 💙Angela Fusca

We had such a great experience at this animal emergency hospital with our kitten. They got us seen right away, and everyone was so kind and caring. The girl at the front desk was especially welcoming and explained all the costs upfront before anything was done, which we really appreciated. They took amazing care of our kitten and made a stressful situation so much easier. Highly recommend!

I can't praise this Vet Hospital enough. My German Shepherd Akadence had some face swelling Dr McGookey and staff all went above and beyond from the moment we arrived, to include some quick next day after care. The urgency and care they provided was truly remarkable. Thank you for taking care of my fur baby. In the future if there is ever an emergency I know where we are going with Akadence. Thank you thank you thank you 💯

Our dog had a really deep cut on his toe and the team did a great job with him. All 3 vets and team members we saw explained what they were doing step by step and what it would take to get him healed.  Happy to say now he’s out there running around again like nothing happened.

This place is wonderful. Was the closest place to our house, so we went, and were blown away by the quality of service. Everyone there was super cool, did a great job taking care of our baby Ava, and did so very cheaply. They also accepted Scratchpay. The entire experience here was actually fun, and we had some good laughs with several staff members. Bring your pet here! Period.

Took my pet here yesterday, Im very unsatisfied with the service and outcome. The vet. Didn’t even know what to say nor did he even know my Dogs temp which was taken. The environment is nice, however i was there for an explanation on why my dog is sick and I wasn’t given one. Wasn’t given my dogs labs when leaving. Was told I would receive them by email however I didn’t and had to call bk hours later to have them sent to me. Called and talked to the Manager a bit ago and wasn’t offered anything but a free exam which is $130.00. I paid over $500 dollars yesterday and fixing to go pay more today somewhere else. Honestly don’t recommend this place at all. I should have looked at the 3.* rating they have before hand.

Update. 4/6/26
The doctor did not  go over the blood work. If he had done so. My pets blood work wasn’t in normal range he had several things that were high and a few that were about to drop below. Yes I did decline the iv and med for upset stomach since he was still letting me give him fluids and he didn’t have an upset stomach. I was offered a free exam like I mentioned but that was it

We are so grateful for the care at Animal Emergency Room. From the moment we called, we had helpful guidance on what to do for our pet. They were prompt to address our needs, and they were very up front with cost and our options. They were extremely communicative throughout the process of diagnosing and treating our pup. Our pet loved the staff, and I could tell the staff really cared for her too. Would recommend this to a friend and will definitely return the next time my dog decides to binge eat all my holiday sweet treats!

2024: Did a quality of life check on my doggie. The front desk staff is kind and calm, and the vet that I spoke with was so compassionate and reassuring. This place continues to be a calm in a storm of sadness. I find the prices for care are also incredibly reasonable.

2021: I just want to thank the vet techs and vet at Animal Emergency Room. We got home on Monday and saw our outdoor cat was in bad shape. We knew he had cancer, and it was just time. He hadn't eaten, and he was weak. The male vet tech saw us quickly, and even more so, kindly and compassionately. His demeanor was calm. I also appreciated the kind words from the female vet tech who thanked us for bringing him in so he could pass quickly, asked us if we needed more time, and then very kindly cleaned him up afterward and left us with a card stating their condolences and even gave us an ink print of his paw. It really touched my heart. The vet too gave us his condolences and told us to stay for as long as we needed.

I can't imagine how difficult it is being a vet in an ER. I was really moved by how great the entire staff was as we helped our kitty pass quickly. Thank you again to the whole team.
10/10 the staff and the doctor were amazing at taking care of my little bud. They explained everything in detail and answered my questions, thank you very much for helping ☺️

Our dog past away on June 5 2025 because a truck ran over her right infront of me and didn’t stop, sadly she past away a month later the staff send us a letter. This emergency room deserve more then 5 stars❤️
Staff is very patient and understanding.

Hello ,I am sorry you did not have a 5 star visit with our clinic. I could not locate you in our records with the information you have provided .Please reach out to admin@animaler .net So we can discuss how to improve our services .
Very kind and caring. My kitty and I thank you. He'll be 8 this year !

I want to give our utmost gratitude to the Animal Emergency Room, especially  thanks to Allison (front desk) who saw we were upset as we walked in with our Groot, our pittie. He was extremely ill and we were afraid we were losing him. Then our thanks to Dr Botros and his Tech Elizabeth. Really everyone was excellent and they not only treated him medically but they showered him with love. We cannot thank you all enough. I will always recommend you for Emergencies .

Just called and the lady whom answered the phone was extremely rude. I told her I wanted to take my dog in because he had a mass on leg and what seemed to look like fluid in his belly. She stated they couldn’t do nothing for him because it was an emergency place and they worked only with animals who got ran over etc definitely would not recommend was not compassionate about my situation and Dr wouldn’t be able to tell me anything

I took my dog ​​to the clinic at night for a health issue that required veterinary evaluation, and they refused to see him.

Instead of guidance or help, I received intimidating comments, which was very distressing as a responsible owner seeking medical attention.

I find it unacceptable that a veterinary clinic is unprepared to handle large or working breed dogs, or that they don't know how to communicate their limitations respectfully and professionally.

A very bad experience. I do not recommend it.

We would like to extend our deepest gratitude to Dr. Buck and the entire staff for the outstanding care they provided to our Musa. Their compassion and professionalism transformed what began as a horrific and stressful situation into a much more manageable experience for us. From the moment we arrived, we felt completely comfortable entrusting Musa to their capable hands. Knowing that Dr. Buck and the team possess the experience required to handle life-threatening emergencies gave us immense reassurance during a very difficult time. We will be forever grateful to everyone at the clinic for their dedication and support. The level of care we received deserves much more than a five-star rating; words cannot fully express our appreciation.
They don’t care about animals at all.

My sweet little boy was euthanized on January the 17th 2026 at 11:06 p.m. I couldn't see him suffer anymore people were so beautiful and nice to me and I thank you so very much hardest thing I have ever had to do I thought he would be here with me forever but he is in heaven loving his other best life way better place

Brought my cat in for an eye injury, they were quick to see her. The Vetenarian is very nice, makes you feel at ease and makes sure you understand the medical terms in depth. It is pricey for the visit but considering its an emergency room its still reasonable.
took very good care of my Bella  they save her life and affordable..All staff so friendly and helpful and caring for her I definitely recommend this Pet Hospital

Called in at my dogs most vulnerable time and they quoted us $130 to see him and then we get there and suddenly there’s a $200 fee for absolutely nothing, trying to charge $600 for an xray (absurd) and after everything said my dog would be dying if I didn’t leave him there overnight for over $1200. Found a different animal hospital that charged me the same thing I paid here for 3 hours — keep my dog overnight for the same cost and did the X-rays free. Such a scam.

I was very grateful to have found this place! My cat was in a fight with a housemate and his ear was wounded. He developed an abscess on his ear so I called the nearest animal emergency clinic, which was this one. The wonderful and amazing receptionist Alison answered all my questions and recommend we get him in right away. The technicians CiCi, Connery and Wendy came to greet us right away. She took our baby to the back to get vitals. The doctor, Dr. McGookey came and spoke with my spouse and I and gave us an estimate for treatment. The prices were very affordable compared to other animal emergency rooms in the area. They also offered alternate payment options in the form of Cherry, a low credit base payment option you apply for online. I decided to try it out and I got approved! Even with my mediocre credit score. I was so happy Allison told us about it. We were prepared for a large bill, thankfully the prices were reasonable and we were able to use Cherry to split up our payments. Thank you Dr. McGookey and AER TEAM!! You are all so professional and compassionate. Our Tubs is home and happy. Thank you so much!
They were so quick with helping my Bella get better and back to her happy self! Worked with my budget which I truly appreciate!!
Took my dog here after she ate a grape and I found out that grapes can cause kidney failure in dogs. They helped me call animal poison control. Didn’t need any intervention and didn’t charge me

Our dog needed emergency surgery due to an accident. They got us in right away and explained everything in detail. They are on the expensive side, but that is not unexpected in an emergency environment.  They took great care of my doggo and us at the same time. The vet tech and the vet were both amazing in a very stressful situation. I am thankful for the great care that my dog
received.
They help my dog fast I love the Animal emergency room great vet thank you for what you did with my dog and thank you Connery for your help also  ❤️ love you guys

They were able to see our dog, Sandy, right away and was able to help in a fast but timely manner . Mercades was very nice and helpful and the doc was very knowledgeable . We were able to bring Sandy back home within a few hours and the pricing was affordable 🐾 …

The best. Don’t go anywhere else for your pets emergencies.  Dr. McGookey was awesome vet. Did not rush and was very thorough. The tech Connery not enough kind words to say about him. Very polite, understanding and listened to my concerns.

Mercades is truly one of a kind! She went above and beyond to make sure our pet felt comfortable and cared for. Her kindness, patience, and expertise really shine through. We’re so lucky to have her taking care of our furry family member. Thank you, Mercades, for being amazing!
Wonderful veterinary clinic! Mercedes , was so gentle with my baby, Harley, she was in so much pain! I’m so thankful for our them! Honest care ! Thank you !

The gentleman doctor who works here was incredible. He gave us wonderful advice about our dog’s botched surgery and got us on track to treat this properly. I told him about our awful experience with Banfield and he decided not to charge us for our consultation because of our terrible situation. What a kind, honest, respectable gentleman. I gained so much respect for this place. That is a true man of the people.
Very appreciative of the staff who saw my baby on Friday! Very prompt, gave thorough explanation, and made me feel good about bringing my pet home. Thank you to Allison, Kellie, and Dr. Bostros!!

Animal Emergency Room deserves recognition, and the reason I’m writing this review is because of the amazing service I received from Genevieve at the front desk. She was the first person I interacted with, and right away she made a stressful situation feel more manageable. Her professionalism, kindness, and calm demeanor truly stood out and made a lasting impression.
Beyond that, the entire team at this clinic was phenomenal. The technicians and assistants were incredibly compassionate and efficient, treating my pet with care and urgency. The doctor took time to explain everything clearly, answered all my questions, and genuinely seemed invested in my pet’s well-being. You can tell this place is filled with people who love what they do. If you’re ever in need of emergency care for your pet, I highly recommend Animal Emergency Room. They’ll take care of your furry family like it’s their own.

Aweful service
Way too expensive
Brought my cat with a broken leg at 9:00 pm
Spoke to a technician was told they couldn’t do much that I needed to take to a orthopedic surgeon
So I thought maybe a splint meds and go home
But NO  ……wait 3 hours plus to bring back my cat just like I took him with only pain meds and a big charge of 800.00
Not recommending to his place at ALL

Special thanks to Allison and Cierra! I took my Animal Care Service (ACS) foster dog there late Friday night for some X-rays and scans. I was lucky it wasn't very busy and the dog was inducted, tended too, scanned and returned to me in 45 minutes. They were very sweet to the dog who is old and wasn't feeling well.

Lady in the front was really nice!! But didn’t like this place! They charged us $800 for X-rays he had a broken jaw and they said they had to pop my dogs leg back in place but couldn’t do it and still charged us another $800 I will never go here again!

I brought my cat Dasha, in on the 25th at around 10pm. The doors are locked and the woman at the front desk comes to let you in. She is not empathetic or even friendly. I work in death care myself and she needs a course in empathy. They take your pet to the back without you. So my housecat who rarely left her home was afraid for her last few hours of life I'm sure. I could hear her crying from the back. She was also suspiciously calm by the time i did get to see her, which was not normal at all, so i feel like they may have given her something to calm her down without my knowledge. The vet ended up diagnosing her with kidney failure. He came to discuss our options and of course I was in tears hearing all of this because my cat seemed full of life yesterday. I asked him if he knew how long she had and he laughed and told me he wasn't God so he wouldn't know. I thought this very unprofessional. I ended up choosing to euthanize her. So I brought my best friend of 17 yrs in for her death and was charged almost 900 dollars for it. When we went back in to be with her during that time they blew a vein on her IV so she wasn't falling asleep. The whole thing felt odd and they asked us to step out. Im not sure what exactly went on but it felt fishy and I am unable to heal thinking about it. We bought an urn for her ashes and it came faster than they said it would, which I was happy about but I probably wouldn't bring another pet here. I would, however, like to commend the technician on how we were treated that night. I don't remember her name but she was short and had brown hair. She was very patient, calm, empathetic and professional. I would like to thank her.

No one wants to end up with their pet at the emergency vet but if you do have to go, then I would recommend this clinic. Dr Buck was very nice, empathetic and transparent. The staff was very nice, helpful and friendly. Thank you Dr Buck, Jaime & Allison.

This place is amazing. The entire staff showed care and compassion towards my boxer puppy Lola. I couldn’t have picked a better place to bring her. They were friendly and efficient and communicated with me the entire time. I didn’t have to wait for a long time they took care of Lola as soon as we walked in. This is truly one of the best experiences I’ve had at an animal hospital. Thank you for everything, hoping my Lola gets better soon. Shout out to Breanna, thank you for all the help

It’s been less than 2 weeks so I’ll just give you the end.
They told us, We are going to give your dog an antibiotic injection, injection for cough, and an injection for cough that will also help her sleep.  If the medication that helps her sleep is too strong for her, give her half.
She was so drugged up she could barely walk.  She went to go lay down and never woke back up.
All this happened within an hour after we left.
I called to tell them the medicine was too strong and they said, there was nothing they could do and sorry for your loss. My baby is dead and I just bought $500 worth of medication they will not take back an hour after leaving.
I am so angry. Why did I go there!!!!!!!

After having a terrible experience with another 24 hour pet clinic off of Hausman... I was referred here. The place itself is small and pricing is reasonable.

I was looking for temporary hospitalization for my ailing dog who was in the end stage of her life. I asked if they would be willing to accommodate until we could proceed with the "putting to sleep" arrangements with her primary vet. This idea did not fly with the previous clinic as my only options were treatments, euthanasia, or taking my dog home.

With the staff at AER, my request was considered and honored. The end of life was accommodating and the staff was very understanding. Thank you to Staff Tech Roberto for taking my request and the rest of the AER staff for giving us dignified last moments with our fur baby.
Exceptional service! I was sorry worried and concerned for my fur baby and Roman assumed my baby would get the help he needed. Dr. McGookey was quick and polite. Thank you everyone for your support!

My cat passed away at home of old age but I called around San Antonio and this place was the most reasonable for cremation. Upon arrival they come outside and up to your car to ask what the reason for the visit is.they were very fast too! I …

My girl woke up vomiting the other day, sick not eating and painful. Took her In and she was diagnosed with pancreatitis. There is a medication available that treats this illness very quickly. This is important because pancreatitis can be …

Allison and Roberto gave excellent customer service . We showed up after 12 pm midnight because our fur baby was sick and they made us feel right at home under stressful circumstances. Glad we chose this animal hospital.

We got there, Noone else in line.  lady made us fill out forms then guy said wait in your car till we can see you.    wth....we were o ly one there, our dog was real sick......rude staff.     A male staff told a lady that walked up after us …

Brought my sick pup and everyone from the vet to the staff were so helpful. I'm glad I brought my Zoey here. Price was reasonable
Really recommend this place

Thank you for the 5-star review! We truly appreciate your support and are so glad we could provide a positive experience. We’re here whenever you need us!
-Animal Emergency Room

Came in on Christmas Day, our lil Tocino was not feeling well and so we wanted to bring him to be sure. They were one of few places that were open and we were expecting a long line and a heavy estimate…. Not the case! They only did what was …
I will never take my dogs anywhere else. Dr. McGookey and the staff there are so compassionate and caring❤️

Took my sweet elderly cat here last night.They where very kind in a difficult situation. They explained to my family what to expect when Joy was crossing the rainbow bridge.Thank you all for being so kind.

The vet was very rude and disrespectful with telling us our baby had parvo she had no sort of  remorse and was very inconsiderate  sounded annoyed.. they charged us $250 just to tell us he had parvo and would’ve charged us an additional …

If I could give 0 stars I would, I took my puppy here and spent 256$ just for them to diagnose him and then wanted to charge me 500$ more to send me home with medicine. The vet was very incompassionate and rude. I will never be taking my baby here again. Seems all they want is the money and not actually help the animal.

Thank you so much for the 5-star review! We’re glad to know you had a positive experience with us. If there’s anything more we can do to assist you or your pet in the future, please don’t hesitate to reach out. … More
